people.imagined: The high herb terrace at dawn. She has just rung the wooden bell for the children's weeding and is wiping soil from her hands onto her apron, the gourd at her hip smelling of every herb at once.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high green terrace at dawn, a wooden bell hanging from one hand, wiping the other palm on her apron, looking out to the children below. Face: a square, sun-browned, solid face with strong cheekbones, wide-set kind dark eyes, thick straight brows, a broad nose, a firm warm mouth; weather lines at the eyes; about fifty. Hair: black with grey at the temples, in a thick low knot under a wide straw hat tied with a cloth under the chin. Body: square, strong, short-waisted, shoulders broad, a farmer's planted stance. Clothing: a long knee-length apron of stiff cream cloth, soil-marked but clean, over an undyed linen shirt and trousers, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a rope belt. Hands and objects: soil under her nails, clearly visible; a purple-brown gourd hung at the hip on a cord; a plain wooden bell held by its cord in the left hand; a lotus-leaf fan tucked in the belt. Background: green terraced slopes stepping down to a river, children small as dots, blurred. Light: low gold dawn from the upper left on the leaves. Expression: warm, practical, patient. A faint soft green Wood hint round her hands. Palette: cream, terrace green, gourd purple-brown.

people.imagined: The stone furnace-house at night. He carries the small bronze censer with its live coal on a chain at his belt and has just heard that someone from Lăng Tiêu may still live. His hand freezes on the lid.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a furnace door at night, one burn-scarred hand frozen on a censer lid, glancing sharply at someone out of frame. Face: a gaunt, hollow-cheeked face with a hawk nose, deep-set dark eyes with a wary shine, heavy dark brows, a thin mouth drawn tight, a few white hairs in a scant beard; about fifty-five. Hair: black going grey, scraped back, in a topknot with a bronze pin. A few strands have come loose from the topknot and stick to the sweaty brow. Body: tall, thin, angular, shoulders high. Clothing: a clean robe of dark-brown fine cloth with an apron of heavy leather, sleeves rolled, a plain belt; small burn holes at the cuffs. Hands and objects: both forearms covered with pale shiny burn scars, clearly visible; a small bronze censer on a chain at his belt, with a live red coal glowing inside through its pierced lid; a pair of iron tongs. Background: a dark stone furnace-house with a glowing red mouth, blurred. Light: red furnace light from the lower left on the face and forearms. The glow from the censer lid shows a ring of pierced stars on the underside of his jaw. Expression: wary, cautious, controlled. A strong warm red-orange Fire hint at the coal. Palette: furnace red, bronze, dark brown.

people.imagined: The landing at dusk, looking down the river toward Lạc Hà. She turns a burnt iron nail between her fingers on a string, her ferryman's hands hard and wiry, thinking of her brother.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a river landing at dusk, a bent burnt nail on a string held between thumb and finger, looking downriver with stubborn eyes. Face: a wiry, sharp, tanned face with high cheekbones, narrow dark eyes, thick straight brows, a straight nose, a hard mouth; a small scar on the chin; about thirty-seven. Hair: black, in a tight braid wrapped round the head under a straw hat pushed back. Body: wiry, tough, lean-armed, a boatwoman's balance. She stands with her weight on her back foot and her shoulders square, arms loose, hands ready like someone about to catch a rope. Clothing: an apron of stiff cream cloth over undyed linen, clean, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rope belt; bare feet on wet stone. The linen shirt has a high round neck and the apron a pocket across the chest holding a few dried herbs; the trousers are rolled to the knee and still damp at the hem. Hands and objects: strong ferryman's hands, thick-palmed, clearly visible; a bent, blackened old iron nail on a string at the neck, held up between the fingers; a small gourd at the hip. Background: a river landing with moored boats, a dusk sky and distant hills, blurred. Moored boats rock at the landing behind her, a burnt black post stands at the water's edge with a rope round it, and far off a faint smoke hangs over distant hills. Light: low orange dusk from the left on the river. The orange dusk lights the nail so that it gleams dull red. Expression: stubborn, loyal, grieving. A faint green Wood hint round the gourd. Palette: cream, river grey-blue, burnt orange.

people.imagined: A flooded rice terrace in the grey of the morning. The old field-warden leans both hands on a hoe he will not let anyone else carry, knee aching, and looks up, knowing the rain is coming before the sky does.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a terrace field with both hands crossed on the top of a hoe handle, looking up at the sky with a squint, one knee bent. Face: a bent old farmer's brown, deeply creased face, a nose like a root, clouded kind eyes, thick white eyebrows, a toothless patient smile, a thin white beard; about seventy. Hair: white and wispy, under a wide straw hat. The hat's wide brim casts a soft shadow over his eyes. Body: stooped, small, gnarled, a hand on the hoe, a bad knee. Clothing: a stiff cream field apron over undyed linen shirt and trousers, clean and mended, sleeves rolled, bare feet in the mud. Hands and objects: knotted hands crossed on a long-handled iron hoe worn smooth by his palms; a small pouch of seeds at the belt; a seed pinched between two fingers of the hand on top. Background: green stepped terraces in grey morning mist, a few dark clouds gathering, blurred. Light: Cool grey light holds no hard shadow, and the wet terrace shines like pewter, from the upper left. Expression: patient, wise, content. A faint soft green and blue Wood and Water hint in the air. Palette: grey-green, straw, cream.

people.imagined: The furnace-house at night, hot bronze smell, her singed eyebrows crooked. She is bent over a small pot of pill-ends she sweeps up, deciding which child will get them, a coin in her fist she never shows.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a hot furnace bench at night, sweeping pill-ends into a small tray, glancing up with a measuring look. Face (most important: crooked singed eyebrows): a sharp, handsome, flushed face with sooty cheeks, narrow bright eyes, eyebrows singed uneven and grown back crooked, one higher than the other, a thin nose, a small clever mouth; about thirty-five. Hair: black, in a high topknot tied with a scrap of red cloth, soot in it. A smear of soot lies across the left temple. Body: slim, wiry, forward leaning, a short leather apron. She stands bent at the hips with her weight on one leg, sleeves pushed up, quick and neat in the way she moves her hands. Clothing: a clean cream apron over a dark-brown linen tunic, sleeves rolled above the elbow, a rope belt; burn marks at the cuffs. The leather apron is scorched at the lower corner, and the cuffs of the brown tunic have small round burn holes. Hands and objects: a small brush sweeping a pile of round dark pills into a bronze tray; the other hand closed round something small, a coin, held against her chest; a small bronze censer on the bench. Background: Behind her the furnace mouth glows, an iron rack of bronze moulds hangs on the wall, and a bucket of water stands ready. Light: red furnace light from the lower left. Orange heat shimmers in the air and lights the edge of her ear. Expression: ambitious, arbitrary, shrewd. A faint red-orange Fire hint. Palette: bronze, furnace red, cream.

people.imagined: His office in Đào Thanh Thành as a price is named. He rubs a ginseng-root charm on a cord between finger and thumb and says the number; the contract on the desk has no one's name on it that he would meet.
people.subject: The moment: seated behind a desk, rubbing a small dried ginseng-root charm hanging at his chest between finger and thumb as he names a price, with a smooth smile. Face: a plump, smooth, genial face with small cold eyes that do not smile, thin arched brows, a flat nose, a smiling mouth with fine teeth, a neat black moustache; about forty-five. Hair: black, oiled and in a high topknot with a jade pin. Body: round, comfortable, leaning back, well fed. His belly rests lightly against the desk edge and his fingers are laced over it, a posture of lazy ease. Clothing: a fine robe of dark-green silk with brown trim, a wide brocade sash, a little cap; richly neat and clean. The robe's brown trim is stitched with a pattern of small linked circles, the cap has a jade bead at the front, and the cuffs are lined in pale green silk. Hands and objects: a small dried ginseng root shaped like a tiny man on a cord at the chest, held in the right hand; a stack of papers with red cord on the desk, marked only with ruled lines; a brass abacus. A small gold ring of a plain band sits on the left forefinger. Background: a rich office with a latticed window onto a river port, blurred. Through the lattice window a busy river with barges loaded with sacks, tiny men with poles, and a long dock of stacked crates. Light: warm light from the upper left. The light from the window warms the papers and shines on his smooth cheek. Expression: affable, callous, calculating. A faint ochre Earth and green Wood hint. Palette: green, brown, gold.

people.imagined: The path to the border, humming as she walks, her left hand curled round a packet of letters as if it were warm; she has read them, and decides to carry on.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a river path humming, left hand curled round a small packet of letters held against her chest. Face: a young, open, friendly face with big dark eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a gentle smile slightly too ready; about twenty. Hair: black, in two braids with green ribbons, a straw hat on her back. Her fennel sprig is a small feathery green spray tucked above the right ear. Body: slim, light-stepping, easy. She walks with her shoulders back and her chin lifted, her gait light as a dancer's, the left arm held close to the body. Clothing: a clean cream apron over an undyed linen shirt and trousers, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; straw sandals. The linen shirt is gathered at the wrist with a green thread and the apron is tucked up at one corner; her sandals have a sturdy knotted strap. Hands and objects: the left hand curled round a packet of folded letters tied with a string; the right swinging a small gourd; a sprig of fennel in her hair. Background: a river path with willows and a distant border hill, blurred. A line of willows trails green fronds into a slow brown river, a ferry waits at a far landing, and the border hill stands pale in haze. Light: warm afternoon light from the upper left. The afternoon light makes the willows glow yellow-green. Expression: humming, friendly, secretive. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: cream, willow green, river blue.

people.imagined: Standing absolutely still among pine trunks on the terrace, so still that two sparrows have settled on his shoulders. His pitted grey face is the colour of pine fungus.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly motionless among pine trunks, a sparrow on each shoulder. Face (most important: pitted grey face): a long, pale grey face pitted all over with small old pockmarks like the surface of a fungus, quiet round eyes, thin pale brows, a small nose, a closed patient mouth; about twenty-two. Hair: thin dark grey-brown, cropped short under a wide straw hat. A small grey feather rests in the hair above his ear. Body: tall, thin, stooped, hands hanging by his side. His arms hang straight at his sides and his feet are together, stiff and quiet as a post, with his head tilted a little as he listens. Clothing: a clean cream apron over undyed linen, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; barefoot among pine needles. The apron has a darn at the knee and the sleeves are rolled to the elbow with a neat double fold; the linen shirt is pale grey, the colour of the fungus. Hands and objects: a small hoe held loosely in the right hand; two small brown sparrows on his shoulders and one on his hat; a ball of grey pine fungus at his feet. Background: dark pine trunks and soft shade, a terrace edge, blurred. Brown pine needles cover the ground, a thin mist weaves between the trunks, and a stack of mossy logs lies by a path. Light: dappled green light from the upper left. A few shafts of light fall through the pines and rest on his shoulders like pale columns. Expression: blank, still, humble. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: fungus grey, pine green, cream.

people.imagined: The sick-house yard, a warden's broken arm in his hands. A wolf-tooth charm swings against forearms knotted from setting bones; he is impatient and gentle all at once.
people.subject: The moment: setting a splint on a broken forearm held out to him, intent, a wolf-tooth charm swinging. Face: a lean, earnest, sunburnt young face with bold dark eyes, straight thick brows drawn in concentration, a firm jaw, a mouth set; about seventeen. Hair: black, short and bristling, a leather band round the head. Body: wiry, a strong lean frame, forearms knotted with muscle. He leans forward with his shoulders hunched in effort and his back leg braced, chin down and eyes fixed on the arm. Clothing: a clean cream apron over a short undyed linen tunic, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rope belt; straw sandals. The apron is stained with old green juice and fastened with two knots at the back; the short tunic has a worn patch at each elbow, and a leather strap holds a pouch of splint strips. Hands and objects: strong hands gripping a patient's splinted forearm; a large grey wolf tooth on a leather cord swinging at his chest, clearly visible; a roll of white bandage cloth at his belt. On his forearms the muscles stand out like ropes, with small scars from old fractures that he has set himself. Background: a sick-house yard with bamboo racks, blurred. A line of low bamboo racks holds drying herbs, a stone water trough stands by the wall, and a wooden bench has a row of splints laid neatly on it. Light: bright light from the upper left. The bright light gives every thread of the bandage a sharp edge. Expression: brave, just, impatient. A faint green Wood hint at the bandage. Palette: cream, bone white, leaf green.

people.imagined: A river market. He smiles slightly, pockets full of dried berries, before he names a price to two people who dislike each other; his own advantage already tucked away.
people.subject: The moment: at a river market stall he smiles slightly and lifts a small bag of berries, about to name a price. Face: a young, round, peaceable, smooth face with soft brown eyes, level brows, a small nose, a slight sly smile, a dimple; about nineteen. Hair: dark brown, in a neat topknot with a green cord. Body: slight, smooth, easy, relaxed shoulders. He stands loosely with his weight on one leg, his shoulders slightly turned in a friendly, open angle. Clothing: a clean cream apron over an undyed linen tunic with sleeves rolled, a rope belt with many small pockets bulging with dried red berries; straw sandals. The rope belt has small cloth pockets of different shades, each stitched with a different coloured thread; the tunic hem is rolled and the sandals are new. Hands and objects: a small cloth bag of dried red schisandra berries held up; a few berries rolling on his palm; a satchel of pill packets at his hip. A satchel strap crosses his chest and a short row of pill packets, wrapped in paper and tied with green string, peeks from the flap. Background: Behind him a row of stalls with striped awnings, a heap of baskets of dried roots, and a long river crowded with small boats. Light: Bright market light makes the berries gleam like tiny red lamps, from the upper left. Expression: peaceable, smooth, quietly opportunistic. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: berry red, cream, river blue.

people.imagined: At the outer gate, lending pine nuts two for one, gold dust under her nails. She holds out a nut and looks at a hungry child with a shrewd little smile.
people.subject: The moment: at a doorway she holds out a single pine nut between finger and thumb to a child out of frame, with a shrewd little smile. Face: a bright, brown, freckled face with quick black eyes, arched brows, a snub nose, a sly little smile with a gap tooth; about sixteen. Hair: black, in two high bunches tied with grey string. Body: small, sturdy, brisk. She stands with feet apart and her free hand on her hip, chin up, the whole small frame set to bargain. Clothing: a clean cream apron over an undyed linen tunic, short sleeves, a rope belt; sandals. The apron is clean cream with two large pockets stuffed with pine nuts, and the linen tunic has a neat double-stitched cuff; a string of dried red seeds is strung round her neck. Hands and objects: fingers with glinting gold flecks under the nails, plainly visible; a small cloth bag of pine nuts held in the left hand; a pine nut in the right. The cloth bag is drawn tight with a cord of twisted grass, and a few extra nuts roll on her palm. Background: A wide rough gate of unplaned timber stands behind her, a few small children's faces peer out from behind a post, and a bare courtyard stretches behind. Light: Bright light shows the gold flecks glittering under her nails, from the upper left. Expression: shrewd, brave, greedy. A faint blue Water hint. Palette: cream, pine-nut brown, gold fleck.

people.imagined: The year she walked into the valley in 480 singing the old song of the four hermits: a woman of sixty with a straw hat and a seedling vine in a basket, laughing, at the edge of a green river plain.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A woman stands at the edge of a green river valley with a basket of seedlings on her arm, singing. Face: a lean, sunburnt, generous face with deep laugh lines, bright dark eyes, a wide mouth open mid-song, thick grey brows; about sixty. Hair: grey, in a loose knot under a wide straw hat tied with a cloth. Body: strong, thin, upright, a picker's stride. Her step is wide and her free arm swings, with the open, rolling stride of a long walker, head thrown back as she sings. Clothing: a long robe of undyed rough linen, belted with a plaited grass rope, sleeves rolled, a cloth apron; bare feet. The linen robe has a wide collar worn soft with years and a hem darkened by river mud, and the grass rope belt carries a small dried gourd and a coil of cord. Hands and objects: a flat basket on the left arm holding small green seedlings and a young gourd vine; the right hand holding a small curved picking-knife; a purple mushroom on a string at her belt. The seedlings in the basket are tied in little bundles with grass, and the picking-knife has a bone handle. Background: a river plain with green mountains, a small hut, blurred. Behind her a long line of three other figures with baskets and hats walks in single file into the valley, and tall green peaks crowd the sky. Light: soft gold light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. The warm light lies low across the plain and makes her face glow. Expression: content, reclusive, generous. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: faded straw, green, purple.

people.imagined: A flooded roof in 924, a herb-picker rowing up to a roof with a four-year-old crouching on it, lifting her gently into his herb basket and speaking softly.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. An old picker kneels in a boat lifting a small child into a big herb basket on his back, gently. Face: a lean, calm, kind weathered face with a long nose, deep eyes full of calm, long white brows, a thin white beard, a faint smile; about seventy. Hair: white, tied in a small knot under a wide straw hat. Body: tall, thin, upright, strong arms. He kneels in the stern with one knee on a plank, back bent, long arms reaching out with great care. Clothing: a long robe of undyed linen belted with grass rope, a straw rain cape over his shoulders, sleeves rolled; clean though wet. The straw cape is made of overlapping bundles of rice-straw tied with twine and dripping, and beneath it the linen robe sticks to his shoulders; his trouser legs are rolled to the knee. Hands and objects: both hands holding a small child (only a small hand and head visible) into a large woven herb basket; a long wooden pole in the boat. The herb basket is large and round with a leather strap, lined with green leaves and filled with a small bundle of wet clothes. Background: grey flood water, a half-drowned roof, rain, blurred. A tilted tiled roof pokes from the brown water, floating branches and broken baskets drift by, and rain stipples the surface. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. A weak pearl light from the cloud gives no hard shadows. Expression: calm, compassionate, quiet. A faint pale green Wood hint in the basket. Palette: faded straw, flood grey, pale green.

people.imagined: The doorway of the sick-house at night. Forty years of poultice have turned his sleeves yellow to the elbow; he looks at the torn hands of a dike child with stubborn tenderness.
people.subject: The moment: at the sick-house door he holds up a child's grazed, bandaged hand to the light, frowning with tenderness. Face: a broad, tired, kind face with deep-set grey eyes, thick grey brows, a heavy nose, a gentle stubborn mouth, a short grey beard; about fifty-five. Hair: grey, cropped short, bareheaded. Body: broad, sturdy, a little stooped, solid. He stands with a slight lean to the left to favour a stiff hip, head bent over the small hand, shoulders heavy. Clothing: a clean cream apron over an undyed linen shirt whose sleeves are stained yellow to the elbow by poultices, sleeves rolled; a rope belt. The cream apron is clean and hemmed, and a string of pale beads tied at his wrist holds a small knife for cutting bandages; sandals show thick brown toes. Hands and objects: both forearms visibly yellowed to the elbow, in view as he holds a small bandaged hand; a bowl of green paste and a stack of clean white cloths nearby. His fingertips are stained pale green and the bandage is rolled neatly in a tight roll beside the bowl. Background: Behind him cots in a long row each with a grey blanket and a still shape, a stack of folded white cloths on a shelf, and a rice-paper window. Light: The lamp makes a warm pool round his hands and leaves the rest of the hall grey, from the upper left. Expression: compassionate, stubborn, honest. A faint soft green Wood hint in the paste. Palette: poultice yellow, cream, soft green.

people.imagined: Dozing in the shade of the lingzhi beds, she tells the mushrooms the news in a murmur, straw sandals mended with three kinds of twine, content to let someone else do the weeding.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stool in lingzhi shade, half asleep, murmuring news to a red-brown mushroom beside her. Face: a soft, lazy, round face with half-closed contented eyes, a button nose, a gentle mouth, a sleepy smile; about forty. Hair: black, in a loose braid under a straw hat. Body: comfortable, round, loose. She sits slumped with her back against a mossy post and her feet stretched out, one hand on her stomach, the ease of a person with nowhere to be. Clothing: a clean cream apron over undyed linen, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; straw sandals visibly mended with three kinds of twine. Her sandals are mended with three kinds of twine, one yellow, one brown, one green, and the apron has a long smudge of red mushroom spore along the front. Hands and objects: one hand resting lightly on the cap of a glossy red-brown lingzhi mushroom the size of a plate; a small tally cord in the other; rows of lingzhi in beds. A small tally cord with a dozen knots trails from her fingers onto the ground. Background: dim, green terraced beds under shade cloth, blurred. Shade cloths of undyed hemp are strung on poles over the beds, and on each bed a rank of glossy red-brown mushrooms rises from dark soil. Light: soft green-filtered light from the upper left. The light is green and cool and the mushrooms shine like lacquer. Expression: lazy, content, gentle. A faint soft green Wood hint round the mushroom. Palette: lingzhi red-brown, green, cream.

people.imagined: Weeding the lingzhi terrace, chewing mint, the corner of her mouth green; she chatters to the mushrooms and makes up the news as she goes.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling between rows of lingzhi, weeding with a small hoe, chewing a mint leaf with a green-stained mouth corner, mid-chatter. Face (most important: green-stained mouth corner): a bright, round, restless face with a wide mouth in mid-talk, the left corner stained green, quick brown eyes, thin arched brows, a freckled nose; about seventeen. Hair: dark brown, in a loose braid with a sprig of mint, a straw hat hanging on her back. Body: small, fidgety, sturdy. She kneels on one knee and leans on the hoe with her free hand on her hip, a quick fidget in the shoulders. Clothing: a clean cream apron over undyed linen, short sleeves, a rope belt; barefoot, knees earth-stained. The apron has a front pocket stuffed with fresh mint stems, and the knees of the trousers are heavily stained green and brown. Hands and objects: a small hoe in one hand and a bunch of weeds in the other; a mint leaf between her teeth; a basket of weeds beside her. The basket beside her is half full of weeds and mint, and a small hand-scythe lies on the ground. Background: neat rows of red-brown mushrooms under shade cloth, blurred. Behind her a long terrace step with rows of red-brown mushrooms under hemp shade, and a larger terrace above with a pale thread of a stream. Light: soft green light from the upper left. Dappled green light falls across her face and the mushroom caps. Expression: chatty, fickle, generous. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: mint green, lingzhi brown, cream.

people.imagined: The sick-house bed, a wound under his hands. He looks up at the ceiling beam while his hands work, because he has learned that looking away steadies them.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a patient's arm, washing a wound, his face turned up toward the ceiling beams. Face: a quiet, calm, thin young face with a long nose, soft dark eyes turned upward, mild brows, a small neutral mouth; about twenty. Hair: black, short, neat, a white head-cloth. Body: slim, steady, calm, narrow shoulders. He stands with his shoulders level and his elbows close, the head tipped back at an odd angle while the hands work steadily below. Clothing: a clean cream apron over an undyed linen tunic, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; damp at the cuffs. The apron has a small knot of grey thread at the pocket and the sleeves are rolled with great exactness, each fold the same width. Hands and objects: both hands holding a bandaged forearm (the patient only a forearm in frame), cleaning it with a wet cloth from a small bowl; a small gourd at his belt. The bowl on the table holds clear water with a pale green leaf floating in it, and a roll of white cloth lies ready beside it. Background: a low wooden sick-house with beams, blurred, a hanging lamp. Along the wall hang bundles of dried herbs, a row of earthen jars, and a hanging gourd; the floor is of swept dark boards. Light: lamp light from the upper left. The lamp light is steady and yellow and leaves the ceiling in shadow. Expression: calm, cautious, gentle. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: cream, wood brown, soft green.

people.imagined: The trade office, mouthing sums under his breath, an abacus bead clicking against his teeth; he is calculating what the mistress gives away for nothing.
people.subject: The moment: at a trade-office desk, clicking an abacus bead against his teeth while mouthing sums, eyes bright. Face: a young, sharp, quick, round face with bright black eyes, thin brows lifted, a snub nose, a mouth mouthing numbers with a bead between the teeth; about eighteen. Hair: black, in a neat topknot under a small cap of black cloth. Body: slight, eager, hunched over the desk. He sits forward on the edge of his stool with his knees together and his elbows on the desk, bent toward the abacus like a bird at a seed. Clothing: a clean cream apron over a dark-green linen tunic with ink at the cuffs, a rope belt. The green tunic has a high collar, the cuffs are inked in a neat line, and the apron has a pocket with a brass pencil case. Hands and objects: a spare wooden abacus bead held at his teeth; the other hand on a full brass abacus; a pill packet on the desk. A neat stack of price slips, each with a different small painted dot instead of writing, lies at his elbow. Background: On the shelf behind him are rows of jars sealed with red wax, a bundle of paper tied in string, and a map of the river drawn in black lines. Light: The bright window light catches the polished brass beads, from the upper left. Expression: eager, greedy, pragmatic. A faint soft green Wood hint. Palette: green, brass, cream.

people.imagined: Pausing at a landing, resting a hand on the rail, a net-knot tied round her smallest finger to remember her father's new net; she is asking again, quietly, to be put on the list.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a landing's rail, one hand resting on it, looking steadily at someone off-frame with a plain request. Face: a plain, honest, patient face with steady brown eyes, level brows, a straight nose, a small closed mouth; about twenty-one. Hair: black, in a single braid pinned up under a straw hat. Body: slim, upright, strong. She stands with feet together and a hand on the rail, her back very straight, shoulders drawn back, as though ready to carry a weight. Clothing: a clean cream apron over undyed linen, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; bare feet. The apron is plain cream with a stitched hem, the linen shirt has long sleeves rolled once, and a knotted cord of grey cotton holds the trousers at the waist. Hands and objects: a small net-knot of cord tied round the left little finger, clearly visible; the left hand on a wooden rail; a bundle of herb stalks in the right. A coil of fishing line hangs at her belt, and the herb stalks in her hand are tied with a thread of blue. Background: a river landing with boats and a fishing net, blurred. A broad river glints behind her, a row of drying nets hangs between two poles, and boats lie on the shingle with their oars stacked. Light: soft light from the upper left. Soft light off the river brightens her plain face. Expression: loyal, honest, patient. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: cream, river grey, rope tan.

people.imagined: Weeding beside the road, her eyes on the road and not on the person speaking to her; the packs may be back. A wolf-bane sprig is in her belt.
people.subject: The moment: standing among weeds with a hoe, looking down the road instead of at the person who is speaking. Face: a thin, hard young face with watchful dark eyes, thick straight brows, a sharp nose, a tight mouth; a fine scar on one cheek; about sixteen. Hair: black, in a short rough braid under a straw hat. Body: thin, wiry, tense. She stands with her feet planted and shoulders hunched, head turned toward the road, hoe held like a spear. Clothing: a clean cream apron over undyed linen, sleeves rolled, a rope belt; sandals. The apron is cream and clean with an edge smudged from kneeling, the linen tunic has a green panel at the shoulder, and a stitched leather band is tied at the left wrist. Hands and objects: a hoe held ready in both hands; a sprig of purple wolf-bane (a hooded flower) stuck in the belt; a small wolf-tooth charm on a cord.
